/personalized-holistic-yoga-assessment.title: Personalized Holistic Yoga Assessment
/personalized-holistic-yoga-assessment.description: A comprehensive initial home consultation and custom posture evaluation followed by a tailored 60-minute practice designed around your lifestyle.

/couple--family-home-yoga.title: Couple & Family Home Yoga
/couple--family-home-yoga.description: A shared interactive yoga session tailored for two or more family members to practice together, fostering bonding, balance, and shared vitality.

/stress--relaxation-yoga.title: Stress & Relaxation Yoga
/stress--relaxation-yoga.description: Deep restorative poses combined with calming pranayama to release nervous system tension and promote restful sleep after long work hours.

/senior-citizen-yoga-practice.title: Senior Citizen Yoga Practice
/senior-citizen-yoga-practice.description: A safe, slow-paced session focusing on joint mobility, balance, and gentle restorative breathing modified for older adults in their own living room.

/beginner-gentle-yoga-session.title: Beginner Gentle Yoga Session
/beginner-gentle-yoga-session.description: A patient, step-by-step introduction to foundational postures and breathing exercises. Ideal for anyone beginning their wellness journey in total comfort.

/back-neck--mobility-support.title: Back, Neck & Mobility Support
/back-neck--mobility-support.description: Targeted gentle stretches and spinal alignment techniques created specifically to relieve desk fatigue, neck tightness, and lower back discomfort.

/weight-management-yoga-support.title: Weight Management Yoga Support
/weight-management-yoga-support.description: An invigorating flow combining energetic vinyasa movement and mindful breathwork to boost metabolic health and build lean endurance at home.

/fitness--flexibility-yoga-session.title: Fitness & Flexibility Yoga Session
/fitness--flexibility-yoga-session.description: A dynamic 1-on-1 home session tailored to deepen your range of motion, build core stamina, and revitalize your energy levels. Designed around your daily routine and fitness goals.
